subject: Thanksgiving week + a little holiday magic (Santa's number inside)
preheader: Pajama storytime, Santa at CityCentre, and holiday hotlines your kids can call.
intro: Thanksgiving break is almost here (no school Nov 23–27), so this week is your calm before the holiday rush. The library carries it with a Baby Godzilla Party for crawlers on Wednesday and Tiny Tykes Pajama Story Time on Thursday (jammies encouraged), then the season kicks off Saturday, Nov 28 with Santa and his reindeer at CityCentre. For a little extra magic, scroll down to Holiday Fun for phone numbers your kids can call (just tap to dial), from Santa to the Grinch.

items.title: Baby Godzilla Party (Baby Bouncer special)
items.description: A special Baby Bouncer playtime for crawlers and first steppers: little ones rampage through a pretend city wearing dinosaur tails. A second session runs 11:15 to 11:45. Space is limited; tickets at the info desk 15 minutes before.

image.alt: Illustration: Toddlers in cozy pajamas holding stuffed animals sit on a rug in a library children area while a librarian reads a bedtime picture book

items.title: Tiny Tykes Pajama Story Time
items.description: A bedtime-themed Tiny Tykes storytime with songs and rhymes for walkers. Pajamas encouraged. A second session runs 11:15 to 11:45. Free tickets are handed out 15 minutes before and run out once the program starts.

image.alt: Illustration: Kids outside a library holding colorful fall leaves over blue light-sensitive paper in the afternoon sun, a librarian showing them how to press the leaves flat

items.title: Fall Leaf Sunprints
items.description: A STEM craft for kids and tweens: pick fall leaves outside and use light-sensitive paper to make blue cyanotype sunprints.

image.alt: Illustration: An outdoor plaza at dusk with a giant decorated Christmas tree and twinkle lights, kids in winter hats meeting a friendly Santa and a reindeer in a small pen, families holding hot cocoa

items.title: Holiday in the Plaza
items.description: Meet Santa and two of his reindeer, with free professional photos, plus holiday singing and dancing. A donation for the SPCA is welcome. Santa leaves at 4 pm, so arrive on time; weather permitting.

items.title: Lupe Tortilla
items.description: Tex-Mex with an outdoor play area, a Houston family favorite for fajita night.

items.title: Ciro's Italian Grill
items.description: Family-owned Italian spot with a two-story space, wood-fired pizza, a gelato bar and a patio with room for kids to play.

items.title: Lazy Oaks Beer Garden
items.description: A shady, laid-back beer garden with a playground, so kids can climb while grown-ups relax.

image.alt: Illustration: A warm, realistic, candid photo in a cozy guest bedroom at a relative's Houston home on Thanksgiving afternoon, landscape

items.title: Your toddler will skip the Thanksgiving nap. Here's how to survive it.
items.description: A loud house, a late dinner and no crib in sight. How to save the nap, make a relative's home safe in 10 minutes and leave early without guilt.

image.alt: Illustration: A warm, realistic, candid photo in a sunny Houston backyard on a cool late-November morning, landscape

items.title: Five days off school? You don't need zero screens. You need a plan.
items.description: SBISD is out Nov 23–27. Why loose days turn into screen marathons, and a no-guilt plan that makes screens a tool, not the whole day.

items.title: SBISD Thanksgiving break
items.description: No school all week. Plan library visits and park days early, since popular spots fill up.

items.title: Neighborhood Nights: Holiday Edition
items.description: A free holiday evening on the lawn: Frozen movie at 6 pm, photos with Santa, Anna and Elsa, letters to Santa, a train ride, cocoa and food trucks. Bring a blanket; no strollers or bikes. Listing end time varies (8 or 9 pm).

items.title: SBISD winter break
items.description: Two weeks off school. We'll round up winter break camps and indoor ideas in December.
